title: TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2611.30419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. translated_title: TamperCert：用于检测学位证书文本篡改的基准数据集
translated_abstract: 学位证书在大学录取、移民和招聘等高风险决策中发挥着关键作用。颁发机构为持证人作担保，因此伪造的证书可能使其持有人通过这些审查。学位证书伪造现象日益猖獗，然而许多人认为伪造证书很容易被识破。公开报道的案例表明事实并非如此：2024年，香港大学商学院发现约30名硕士生持伪造学历证书入学。目前鲜有研究探讨如何检测伪造学位证书，部分原因是公开的基准数据集十分匮乏。我们提出了TamperCert，这是一个基于38所大学颁发的400份真实学位证书构建的基准数据集。每份证书均经过11种公开可用的篡改方法处理以篡改持有人姓名，并进一步应用四种额外的后处理技术，最终生成了超过20,000张伪造图像。我们评估了13种检测方法……
tldr: 该论文构建了首个基于400份真实学位证书、包含超过20,000张伪造图像的篡改检测基准数据集TamperCert，用于评估文本篡改检测方法在识别伪造学位证书方面的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates with over 20,000 forged images generated by 11 tampering methods and 4 post-processing techniques, to evaluate text tampering detection in degree certificates.
